title: QA Pilot MCP Call Loop Guard Packet
description: Schema for QA Pilot MCP call loop guard diagnostic packets. Captures an agent session's MCP tool-call trace and validates that no doom-loop patterns exist: no repeated identical calls, no repeated health checks after success, no unauthorized cross-lane calls, bounded call count, stop reason present, no auto-retry loops. Advisory-only diagnostic surface.

guard_id.description: Unique MCP guard diagnostic identifier (e.g. MG-SESSION-EVAL-001).

session_id.description: The agent session ID being monitored and evaluated.

title.description: Human-readable title for this guard evaluation.

description.description: Context for this guard evaluation — what session, what project, what startup mode.

call_number.description: Sequential call number within the session.

tool.description: The MCP tool name (e.g. project_get_profile, project_get_cursor).

result.description: Result category: success=OK result, not_found=-32602, unreachable=connection error, other_error=other error.

result_detail.description: Full result detail or error message.

phase.description: Session phase in which this call was made.

retry.description: Whether this call was a retry of the same tool with same params after a definitive result.

stop_reason.description: Why the agent stopped after this result (e.g. 'protocol §3.2 states -32602 expected for add-on'). Only present for the terminal call of a sequence.

mcp_calls.description: Chronological trace of MCP tool calls in the session.

cross_lane_calls.description: List of cross-lane call details found.

aggregate.description: Aggregate guard-evaluation results across all MCP calls.

advisory_only.description: All QA Pilot guard packets are advisory. Must be true.

librarian_impact.description: No Librarian mutation permitted. Must be none.

not_seal_authority.description: Explicit assertion that this guard does not confer sealing authority.

not_librarian_mutation_authority.description: Explicit assertion that this guard does not authorize Librarian mutation.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this guard was created.

created_by.description: Agent or tool that created this guard.

allOf.description: If cross_lane_detected is true, cross_lane_calls must be non-empty.
If total_calls=0, bounded must be true (no calls is bounded by definition).
